standard.summary: 相邻 step 误差低于该阈值才复用预览缓存。上游 SmoothCache (arXiv:2411.10510) 是推理期按层表征误差离线标定的 schedule；本仓只有运行时误差阈值与预热步，没有 calibration ⇒ 机制不同。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The preview cache is only reused when the error between adjacent steps is below this threshold. Upstream SmoothCache (arXiv:2411.10510) is an inference-time schedule calibrated offline from per-layer representation error; this repository has only a runtime error threshold and warmup steps, with no calibration => a different mechanism.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 块间误差低于该阈值才复用缓存。阈值越松（越大）复用越多、越快，但漂移越大。该实现使用本地 relative-L1 probe，不能外推 SmoothCache 论文结果。默认 0.08。

advanced_en.principle: Cache is reused only when the inter-block error is below this threshold. Looser (larger) thresholds reuse more and run faster, but drift more. This implementation uses a local relative-L1 probe and cannot be extrapolated to the SmoothCache paper's results. Default 0.08.
